ayahs.en: Woe to those who give less [than due]
ayahs.e2: Woe to the defrauders

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكۡتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسۡتَوۡفُونَ
ayahs.en: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full
ayahs.e2: Those who take full measure ˹when they buy˺ from people

ayahs.en: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss
ayahs.e2: but give less when they measure or weigh for buyers
ayahs.tr: Wa izaa kaaloohum aw wazanoohum yukhsiroon

ayahs.en: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
ayahs.e2: Do such people not think that they will be resurrected

ayahs.en: For a tremendous Day
ayahs.e2: for a tremendous Day—

ayahs.en: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds
ayahs.e2: the Day ˹all˺ people will stand before the Lord of all worlds

ayahs.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينࣲ
ayahs.en: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen
ayahs.e2: But no! The wicked are certainly bound for Sijjîn ˹in the depths of Hell˺—
ayahs.tr: Kallaaa inna kitaabal fujjaari lafee Sijjeen

ayahs.en: And what can make you know what is sijjeen
ayahs.e2: and what will make you realize what Sijjîn is?—

ayahs.en: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
ayahs.e2: a fate ˹already˺ sealed

ayahs.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers
ayahs.e2: Woe on that Day to the deniers—

ayahs.en: Who deny the Day of Recompense
ayahs.e2: those who deny Judgment Day

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
ayahs.en: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor
ayahs.e2: None would deny it except every evildoing transgressor
ayahs.tr: Wa maa yukazzibu biheee illaa kullu mu'tadin aseem

ayahs.ar: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.en: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples
ayahs.e2: Whenever Our revelations are recited to them, they say, “Ancient fables!”
ayahs.tr: Izaa tutlaa'alaihi aayaatunaa qaala asaateerul awwaleen

ayahs.ar: كَلَّاۖ بَلۡۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
ayahs.en: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning
ayahs.e2: But no! In fact, their hearts have been stained by all ˹the evil˺ they used to commit
ayahs.tr: Kallaa bal raana 'alaa quloobihim maa kaanoo yaksiboon

ayahs.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ عَن رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذࣲ لَّمَحۡجُوبُونَ
ayahs.en: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned
ayahs.e2: Undoubtedly, they will be sealed off from their Lord on that Day
ayahs.tr: Kallaaa innahum 'ar Rabbihim yawma'izil lamah jooboon

ayahs.en: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire
ayahs.e2: Moreover, they will surely burn in Hell

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.en: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny
ayahs.e2: and then be told, “This is what you used to deny.”
ayahs.tr: Summa yuqaalu haazal lazee kuntum bihee tukazziboon

ayahs.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
ayahs.en: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun
ayahs.e2: But no! The virtuous are certainly bound for ’Illiyûn ˹in elevated Gardens˺—

ayahs.en: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun
ayahs.e2: and what will make you realize what ’Illiyûn is?—

ayahs.en: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
ayahs.e2: a fate ˹already˺ sealed

ayahs.en: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah]
ayahs.e2: witnessed by those nearest ˹to Allah˺

ayahs.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
ayahs.e2: Surely the virtuous will be in bliss

ayahs.en: On adorned couches, observing
ayahs.e2: ˹seated˺ on ˹canopied˺ couches, gazing around

ayahs.en: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure
ayahs.e2: You will recognize on their faces the glow of delight

ayahs.en: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed
ayahs.e2: They will be given a drink of sealed, pure wine

ayahs.ar: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسۡكࣱۚ وَفِي ذَٰلِكَ فَلۡيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلۡمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
ayahs.en: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete
ayahs.e2: whose last sip will smell like musk. So let whoever aspires to this strive ˹diligently˺
ayahs.tr: Khitaamuhoo misk; wa fee zaalika falyatanaafasil Mutanaafisoon

ayahs.en: And its mixture is of Tasneem
ayahs.e2: And this drink’s flavour will come from Tasnîm—

ayahs.en: A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink
ayahs.e2: a spring from which those nearest ˹to Allah˺ will drink

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَضۡحَكُونَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed
ayahs.e2: Indeed, the wicked used to laugh at the believers
ayahs.tr: Innal lazeena ajramoo kaanoo minal lazeena aamanoo yadhakoon

ayahs.en: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances
ayahs.e2: wink to one another whenever they passed by

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓاْ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ
ayahs.en: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting
ayahs.e2: and muse ˹over these exploits˺ upon returning to their own people
ayahs.tr: Wa izan qalabooo ilaaa ahlihimun qalaboo fakiheen

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوۡهُمۡ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
ayahs.en: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost
ayahs.e2: And when they saw the faithful, they would say, “These ˹people˺ are truly astray,”
ayahs.tr: Wa izaa ra awhum qaalooo inna haaa'ulaaa'i ladaaal loon

ayahs.en: But they had not been sent as guardians over them
ayahs.e2: even though they were not sent as keepers over the believers

ayahs.ar: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ يَضۡحَكُونَ
ayahs.en: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers
ayahs.e2: But on that Day the believers will be laughing at the disbelievers
ayahs.tr: Fal yawmal lazeena aamanoo minal kuffaari yadhakoon

ayahs.en: On adorned couches, observing
ayahs.e2: as they sit on ˹canopied˺ couches, looking on

ayahs.ar: هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ ٱلۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
ayahs.en: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do
ayahs.e2: ˹The believers will be asked,˺ “Have the disbelievers ˹not˺ been paid back for what they used to do?”
ayahs.tr: Hal suwwibal kuffaaru maa kaanoo yaf'aloon
